concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payto-ios-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured PayTo iOS Components Sessions/Advanced guide for one-off and subscription agreement setup, await action, agreement-bound later payments and webhook outcomes; source flags link, token-reference and example caveats.
warnings: An accepted bank agreement, Pending/await response or token is not itself payment authorization; AUTHORISATION may be authorized or rejected.
Sessions routes subsequent subscriptions to Advanced/API-only even though it includes a stored-method Component initialization tab; keep server-side flow distinct.
Advanced base-guide link points to Drop-in, action link names redirect while action.type is await, and webhook token references vary across sections.
Multiple request examples contain missing commas or shell continuations; do not treat them as copy-ready.
The Sessions subscription example omits required storePaymentMethod: true; use the required-field table rather than copying it.
